implemented: Added a shared helper `location_relative_path(file_path, root_dir)` to crates/tldr-core/src/surface/resolve.rs implementing the empty-strip -> file_name() fallback (mirroring the inline Python fallback at python.rs:443-453), and routed all 18 non-Python surface frontends through it so single-file surface targets emit a non-empty location.file.
root_cause: Every non-Python surface frontend computed location.file via `file_path.strip_prefix(root_dir).unwrap_or(file_path).to_path_buf()`. For a single-file surface target the resolver sets root_dir == file_path, so strip_prefix collapses to an empty PathBuf, producing location.file == "". Only python.rs had the file_name() fallback.
fix: One shared AST-agnostic path helper (no regex/string heuristics), called from each frontend's relative_path computation. Replaced 22 identical strip_prefix blocks across 18 files with a single call site each.
generalization_test: crates/tldr-core/src/surface/resolve.rs::tests::single_file_surface_emits_nonempty_location_across_languages drives a real single-file extract through the per-language frontend for go, rust, scala, ruby (representative of the ~18 non-Python symptom class) and asserts every entry has a non-empty location.file equal to the file name. Also added location_relative_path_falls_back_to_file_name_for_single_file_target unit test for the helper.
